To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the manufacturing flexibility is achieved through a combination of people, technology, innovation, and continuous improvement.

(1) technology is a prerequisite to attain flexibility, (2) people are the key enabler of flexibility, (3) innovation and continuous improvement are complementary, (4) flexibility is a function of the combination of technology, people and innovation, (5) continuous improvement is a prerequisite for flexibility, (6) innovation and continuous improvements are complementary to achieve flexibility, and (7) flexibility is a result of combining the four factors.
technology, innovation, continuous improvement and people should be combined to achieve flexibility.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of technology and people and their interaction with the role of innovation and continuous improvement in achieving manufacturing flexibility.
the factors of technology and people, and innovation versus continuous improvement in manufacturing flexibility, and their contribution to the achievement of manufacturing flexibility.
the role of people, technology, innovation and continuous improvement in achieving manufacturing flexibility.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
flexibility could be achieved by combining people and technology and by applying innovation and continuous improvements together.
technology and people, as well as innovation and continuous improvement are the two opposing factors that contribute towards flexibility.
the combination of technology, people and continuous improvement and innovation would yield the desired flexibility in manufacturing.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
flexibility can be obtained through the combination of technology, people, innovation, continuous improvement and other factors.
the combination of technology and people is necessary to achieve manufacturing flexibility, as well as the combination of continuous improvement and innovation.
flexibility is achieved through the integration of technology and people.
The main takeaway from our work is that
technology alone is not sufficient to achieve flexibility.
flexibility could be achieved by using technology, people, and continuous improvement and innovation simultaneously.
technology and people are not opposing factors, but rather, complementary ones.
